test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Consider the statements given below and identify the correct answer.

**Statement I:** The Modern Periodic Table has 18 vertical columns known as 'periods' and 7 horizontal rows known as 'groups'.

**Statement II: **Groups in the Periodic Table signify an identical outer shell electronic configuration

options.text: Statement II is correct, Statement I is incorrect.
Statement I is correct, Statement II is incorrect.

solution:
The correct answer is **Statement II is correct, Statement I is incorrect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Modern periodic table is an **arranged format of the elements** according to the **increasing order of their atomic numbers.**
 
• At present, the modern periodic table has **118 elements**.
 
• **Groups **in the periodic table are the** vertical columns **in the periodic table which has a total of **18 groups.**
 
• **Periods** in the periodic table are the **horizontal rows **in the periodic table which has a total of **7 periods**.
 
• Groups signifies the **outer electronic configuration **and periods signifies the **addition of shells**.

​Thus, here in the given two statements, **Statement II is correct, Statement I is incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Modern periodic table was introduced by **IUPAC**, after the announcement of** modern periodic law by Moseley.**
 
• Moseley's modern periodic law states that, **"The physical and chemical properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic number".**
